change_requests.title: Immutable committed-candidate review receipt and pre-push enforcement
change_requests.objective: Replace mutable working-tree CODE authorization with a deterministic committed-candidate model and an ignored, atomic PASS receipt bound to one exact Git base/head range, immutable snapshot, review material, reviewer result, and CR/task scope.
acceptance_criteria: CR-097 is complete and its vendor-neutral names, schema, verdict semantics, output locations, serious-finding validation, and fail-closed caller contract are used without provider-specific vocabulary.

A canonical UTF-8, LF, deterministic snapshot descriptor is built only from Git objects, includes exact base/head/tree identities, CR scope, and a sorted encoded changed-file manifest, and is SHA-256 bound together with review material and result.

Only review_complete=true, exact PASS, and zero blocking findings can create an atomic ignored dnppv2-code-review-receipt/v1 receipt under build/code-review/receipts; all missing, malformed, stale, contradictory, unavailable, inconclusive, failed, or raced states fail closed.
